outcome: Child BMI at 5 years of age
cohort: 781 mother-child pairs from the ROLO longitudinal birth cohort study
finding: The study identified specific fetal growth trajectories that were associated with maternal serum glucose concentrations during pregnancy, mode of delivery, and child BMI at 5 years of age.
mod_finding: Mothers with a fetus on the fastest growth trajectory were more likely to deliver by cesarean section.
